parsed.rationale: All three members — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — are `type-alias-union` declarations in the same package (`Wallpaper`) with identical structure (`shared_field_count: 16`, `differing_slots: null`), meaning they are exact duplicates sharing all 16 union cases. None carry test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, so the duplication is unintentional. The correct fix is to define a single canonical `BlendMode` type-alias-union in a new or existing shared file within `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/` and replace all three aliases with either a direct rename or thin `typealias` redirects (which can then be deprecated and removed). This eliminates the risk of the three definitions drifting apart as new blend modes are added.
